## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL: mixed directional signals with modest tech leadership vs weak Financials and Energy; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); confirmatory signals = Tech cluster of ABOVE TREND names (AMD, NVDA, QCOM) and weakness in key Financials (WFC, JPM) supporting a neutral read.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +26.19% | 1M: +81.62%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.36% | 1M: +16.62%). Industrials strong: BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +6.63%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +15.43%). Materials showing rotation: FCX RECOVERY (1W: +14.48% | 1M: -2.73%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: VST BELOW TREND (1W: -8.42% | 1M: -7.16%). Energy weak: XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.74% | 1M: -1.32%). Financials lag: WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -12.73%), JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -2.81%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +26.19% | 1M: +81.62%), CVS ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.92% | 1M: +22.92%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.19% | 1M: +32.67%), FCX RECOVERY (1W: +14.48% | 1M: -2.73%), MNST ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.28% | 1M: +14.23%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), signaling cross-sector participation rather than one-sector concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: OXY BELOW TREND (1W: -5.17% | 1M: -3.08%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -12.73%), TGT CORRECTION (1W: -5.45% | 1M: +3.33%), ADBE CORRECTION (1W: -5.79% | 1M: +0.30%), CMCSA BELOW TREND (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -11.23%); weakness concentrated in select Financials and Communication names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Big 1W movers: AMD (1W: +26.19% | 1M: +81.62%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +17.19% | 1M: +32.67%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +60.25%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +12.36% | 1M: +16.62%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present: multiple large-cap names (ADBE CORRECTION, GOOGL CORRECTION, TGT CORRECTION) show 1W/1M sign conflicts — watch for trend break; treat momentum as tactical, not a broad regime shift.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but leading on momentum; AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +26.19% | 1M: +81.62%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.36% | 1M: +16.62%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +6.09%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -8.39% | 1M: -0.87%); sector performance supportive but internals uneven (Tech: 24 stocks positive this week overall).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials soft overall: WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -12.73%), JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -2.81%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.57% | 1M: +5.72%), MA RECOVERY (1W: +0.55% | 1M: -1.72%); breadth and bank names argue for caution in Financial exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare steady-to-mixed: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +26.64%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +6.49%), JNJ BELOW TREND (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -5.76%); sector providing defensive ballast but with idiosyncratic movers to watch.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Growth/tech exposures where momentum is confirmed (AMD, NVDA, QCOM) and favor select Industrials showing fundamental beats (CAT, BA); reduce exposure to stressed Financials and broad Utilities/Energy names showing persistent BELOW TREND behavior. Style: Growth tilt but remain neutral overall given mixed breadth and divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +26.19% | 1M: +81.62%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +26.64%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +60.25%). BEARISH: WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -12.73%), ISRG (-85) — monitor recall fallout (price action needed), CMCSA BELOW TREND (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -11.23%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (momentum cluster; sector up 1W +2.95%), Industrials (data center and cyclicals strength). BEARISH: Financials (sector down 1W -1.05%), Utilities and Energy (both materially negative week-to-date).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: monitor continuation above recent swing highs for trend confirmation (ABOVE TREND). AAPL: hold recent 1M trend support — AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +13.84%). WFC: failure to reclaim 1M trend keeps it BELOW TREND (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -12.73%) and at risk of further underperformance. UNH: breakout follow-through would sustain sector leadership (UNH ABOVE TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MNST (+80): Monster ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.28% | 1M: +14.23%) — sentiment confirmed by strong price action. CAT (+60): Caterpillar ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +15.43%) — guidance/contract news confirming strength. WFC (+70): Wells Fargo BELOW TREND (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -12.73%) — bullish narrative vs weak price is a divergence to monitor.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ISRG (-85): Intuitive Surgical negative headline; monitor for confirming price weakness (sentiment severe). QCOM (-50): Qualcomm ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +60.25%) — sentiment negative but price confirms resilience (divergence). MSFT (-50): Microsoft CORRECTION (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +6.09%) — regulatory headlines add tail risk to a stock on short-term pullback.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth tilt given concentrated tech momentum vs soft Financials; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. AMD, NVDA, QCOM showing relative strength (ABOVE TREND) while WFC and XOM are showing weakness (BELOW TREND). Key risk: major 1W/1M divergences (ADBE, GOOGL, TGT in CORRECTION) and headline-driven names (ISRG, WFC) that could flip the neutral backdrop if confirmed by price.
